key.name: window-width
key.description: The width of the main window, in pixels, restored the next time Opus is opened.

key.name: window-height
key.description: The height of the main window, in pixels, restored the next time Opus is opened.

key.name: sidebar-width
key.description: The width of the sidebar, in pixels, restored the next time Opus is opened.

key.name: style-variant
key.description: Whether to follow the system's light/dark preference, or force a light/dark style regardless of it.
